compiled_state.title: check-test-isolation.sh silently passes host project pre-commit checks
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Summary
plugins/dso/scripts/check-test-isolation.sh line 31 uses
  : \"\${REPO_ROOT:=\$(cd \"\$SCRIPT_DIR/..\" && pwd)}\"

The script is wired into host pre-commit chains (.pre-commit-config.yaml:134). On a host project, the shim resolves SCRIPT_DIR to the plugin cache, so REPO_ROOT defaults to the plugin root. The subsequent \`git diff --cached --name-only\` at line 56 then runs inside the plugin cache directory — either erroring (no git repo) or returning an empty diff. Net effect: silent pass; host's staged test files are never checked for isolation violations.

The := makes the env-override path acceptable (PROJECT_ROOT=… works), but the DEFAULT is wrong. Hosts that haven't set PROJECT_ROOT get the silent pass.

## Reproduction
1. Install DSO plugin on a host project, wire check-test-isolation.sh into pre-commit.
2. Stage a test file with a known isolation violation.
3. Commit. Observe: pre-commit reports PASS (false negative).
4. Verify the script ran inside the plugin cache: add `echo \"DEBUG: pwd=\$(pwd) REPO_ROOT=\$REPO_ROOT\" >&2` near line 56.

## Fix
Replace line 31 with:
  REPO_ROOT=\"\${PROJECT_ROOT:-\$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)}\"
Hard-error on empty REPO_ROOT.

Also fix line 34 (RULES_DIR=\$REPO_ROOT/scripts/test-isolation-rules) which currently masks-as-working because REPO_ROOT resolves to plugin tree. The rules dir is a plugin-shipped resource; should be \${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/test-isolation-rules.

## Discovered by
Opus audit subagent on 2026-05-28 during PR-4 host-portability review.
